verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS collaboration product lets users keep their data out of AI model training is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-use policy, or any training-exclusion control. The AI-related items cover MCP, agent support and the CLI, which are different capabilities. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
